messages:
maya: Quick coordination thread — planning a small schema migration on the user_emails table TOMORROW 05:30 UTC. Quiet window ~3h. Goal: deploy v3 index, enable dual-write for 30m, kick off backfill job after canary. Who can own deploy and smoke?

sam: I can own deploy. I’ll be online 05:15-06:45 UTC. Will take rollback if needed.

raj: Can we do a staged canary? 1% for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> full. Dual-write window stays 30m? Also confirm read-path compatibility with v3 index.

maya: yes to the staged canary plan. dual-write 30m (start at canary begin). Read path validated on staging — Lina ran the quick perf check yesterday.

lina: confirmed staging perf: p95 latency +2ms with v3. I’ll be smoke lead. Quick smoke checklist: basic writes, reads, index health, and a sample read rollback test.

maya: placing ops calendar invite and tagging oncall DB. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/inference/runbooks/db-migration-v3 

lina: smoke commands (run from bastion /ops):
```
# verify index exists
psql -d users -c "\x\nSELECT indexrelid::regclass, indisvalid FROM pg_index JOIN pg_class ON pg_index.indexrelid=pg_class.oid WHERE pg_class.relname='user_emails_idx_v3';\n"\n# quick write+read
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood:8443/test-user -d '{"email":"smoke+1@redwood.test"}'
# check backfill queue
kubectl -n jobs get jobs | grep user_emails_backfill
```

sam: noted. I’ll run the smoke checklist and post results in this thread. If anything fails we 1) pause canary 2) flip dual-write off 3) run rollback migration. Rollback steps are in the runbook.

deploy-bot: canary job scheduled -> job_id:98765, canary windows: 1% @05:30 for 10m, 25% @05:40 for 15m. Notifications will appear in #eng-oncall.

raj: who’s owning DB-level rollback (ALTER INDEX drop/rename)? I can assist but need the DB owner to execute.

maya: pinging @dba-team in the calendar invite — DB owner oncall will be present. raj: please coordinate with them 05:20.

lina: small note — backfill job will write to a temp table then swap; that swap has a short lock (~5s) but is covered by quiet window. Monitor for lock_timeouts.

sam: I’ll post smoke pass/fail and attach logs. If pass -> proceed to full rollout after 25% hold. If fail -> rollback and bubble to incident if inability to rollback cleanly. :thumbsup: 

maya: perfect. Thanks everyone — I’ll add the checklist to the invite and update the runbook with the exact CLI snippets. Ping this thread if anything changes before 05:00 UTC.
